title: Make someone talk
blurb: Walk up to the club president, press E, and they say your words.
how: @on_talk("host") tells the game: when the player presses E on the spot named host, run the function under this line. On this map host is the club president.
Every yield say(...) puts one line in the box and waits for the player to click. Three says, three clicks.
who="host" puts the speaker's name on the box. Leave it off and the box has no name on it.
The word yield matters. Without it the line does nothing and Python doesn't warn you.
try: Change what the president says. Press Run, then press E on the president.
Add a fourth line. Copy one of the yield say lines and change the words.
Make the computer talk too. Copy the whole block, change "host" to "the_desk" on the @on_talk line, and give the function a new name.
breaks: Nothing happens when you press E
